## What's new

**Toggle Vencord (Windows)**
- At the bottom of the Friends in Voice page, next to *Check for updates*, **Toggle Vencord** closes Discord and opens it again as normal Discord, without Vencord or any plugin.
- To turn Vencord back on, open the **Discord + Vencord** shortcut it puts on your desktop. It also works after Discord updates itself. Running the installer again turns it back on too.
- Only the Discord you're using is touched (PTB and Canary are left alone). Your settings and plugins stay where they are.

## Update

Use the update notification in Discord, or the installer at https://friendsinvoice.sarhsoft.com. If it fails, download `FriendsInVoice-v1.24.0.zip`, extract the whole archive and run `repair.bat` (macOS: `repair.command`, Linux: `bash repair.sh`).

BetterDiscord: replace the installed plugin with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release and enable it.
